source:
## 2026.8.l.31 - "THE HEART HAD BEEN AN APPLE ONCE"

- there are now three dialogue speeds: CALM, QUICK and CRISP. Try 'em out and see which one works for you.
- related: fix for the stuttering effect in dialogue - typewriting in CALM and QUICK is much smoother (CRISP has no typewriting at all)
- you can now use a mixture of Experiences rather than all of one type to increase (but not evolve) a Skill or Passion, making it much easier to increase.
- Skill increase costs up to 10 have been halved for both career and non-career skills; you can also increase a skill to 9 at character generation
- these aren't final numbers! We'll tune as the game grows. But I wanted to let people try out more skill increases in the demo.
- We're now supporting non-QWERTY keyboard layouts as best we can. I've tried it with French and German, most other Latin layouts should work. If yours doesn't, send us an F10 and we'll see what we can do
- related: LeftAlt now works as well as Z for interactable highlighting
- We've updated the keyboard shortcuts image to take account of recent changes. (still shows QWERTY, no rebinding options yet, don't get too excited)
- Spencer is now much less likely to run backwards
- you should no longer be able to start a conversation while changing scene.
- added skill checks to certain occult actions in Chez Felix - laying the groundowrk for making occult actions clearer
- Lucifer Match now has the Unveil aspect (ditto)
- footnote text-search now includes tutorial messages that you've seen (except some highly incidental/specific ones)
- softened the lines on the crafting menu, added click-to-lock skill headers, fixed a typo
- prettified ending screen
- prettified Aspect Pool
- three memories had a stack size of 1, fixed to 99
- you'd have got this patch yesterday but I found a wretched bug that meant the inventory-drag would inexplicably force-drop items. After two hours of bug-hunting it turned out to be a bug that only surfaced in the editor, not in the actual build you lot see. I'm 95% certain of this, so if you see it, for God's sake send me an F10.

## 2026.8.l.5 - "SEVERE GALLERIES IN SECRET CIRCLES"

- Lots of work on the look and feel of the map! You can't enjoy this properly yet while there's still only one travel destination, but the experience is more elegant when you do (vignette, Spencer bubble, fun-er button, bigger hitboxes for cities, prettier selection marker)
- halved the default tooltip delay (won't affect existing installs, but you can still reduce tooltip delay in config)
- much harder to select dialogue options by mistake! we wait for a quarter-second after the text completes, and we don't select the first option unless you hit an arrow key, so you can safely hammmer space. Also, down arrow now advances text.
- if you switch from crafting to inventory at a venue, then back, crafting remembers the venue
- walking near puddles should no longer provoke weird behaviour from Spencer
- game will no longer crash if you have the wrong permissions on your save folder
- camera movement tutorial popup
- lots of fiddly highlight bug fixing
- if you've met someone but they have no opinion of you yet, journal will show 'Uncertain' not 'Unmet'
- LOAD GAME button disappears when there are no saves, matching continue button
- bug report character limit of 3000 characters (we're still at support@weatherfactory.biz if you want a more prolix option)
- clarified 'consumed' vs 'exhausted'
- Linou varies her lines when you're doing conjuring tricks.
- the Antibes welcome zone no longer rotates Spencer. Don't look back in anger.
- load/save menu scroll now works the first time you open it

## 2026.8.k.98 - "MR COGITO OBSERVES A DECEASED FRIEND"

- reduced PERHAPS EVEN REMOVED chance of getting stuck when opening a private door Chez Felix
- spamming double clicks no longer seizures Spencer
- 'Reset Tutorial Message' button doesn't get stuck as apparently-disabled
- running back and forth past Vincent should no longer frighten him
- aspects on skill and passion cards are now alphabetised (which will imminently be more relevant)
- sorting n walking fixes in the dreamitarium
- better requirement copy for countable items

##  2026.8.k.83 - "THE INVISIBLE CITY WHICH OCCUPIES THE SAME SPACE"

- pathfinding update! Clicking unreachable ground (red dot) now refuses outright, rather than trying to walk you as close as possible (this was the cause of numerous pathfinding issues)
- the can't-go-there red dot now gives audio feedback and fades after a moment
- using UNSTUCK should no longer ever catapult you into off-map darkness
- and the usual round of pathfinding and sorting fixes to go with that
- cancel sound plays on ground-click refusal / unreachable path / mid-walk disconnect
- clearer info on 'you need at least this many' 'you don't need this many' requirement text
- a fix to our analytics code that means it won't try so frantically to send details if it misses the first time
- copy fixes, always more copy fixes, il faut imaginer Sisyphe heureux

## 2026.8.k.51 - "THE BIRDS DRUNK ON UNKNOWN SKY-FOAM" 

- major Passions UI rework to make everything prettier, & shows current potential Passions & lets you reject 'em
- fixed a bug where you could have the same potential Passion on two empty ones (which also gave you the wrong evolve cost)
- lots of other tiny grace notes on the character screen skill and passion cards
- lots more character sheet beautification
- and journal beautification: we finally fixed those placeholder reward buttons
- footnotes can now be opened directly with T/middle-click - no more waiting for popup
- footnotes less inclined to coyness after clicking a +/- button on character sheet
- X-close button in same place on all menus
- the occluding darkness that descends when you enter a cutaway now occludes everything. This meant some reworking so do let us know about glitches
- Linou now itemises her bill when asking you to pay
- +/- buttons on character sheet now give audible feedback on success/fail
- music on the character generation screen is ducked; actual dB volume is lower in the bottom half of the music volume slider
- tutorial alerts can't pop up on the character screen
- companion should stop occasionally displaying as a cyan blotch
- can no longer click NPCs and objects inside a shrouded room
- another complicated fix to a Zèlia outcome. Next game it's going to be simple Y-shaped fetch quests with an end decision, damn it
- Sinombre doesn't give upn you as easily
- Welland's painting only gives one option
- Andrée can buy notebooks again, though she still won't sell them
- sock juice counts towards the refreshment tally
- "Troubles" no longer called "Menaces" in the one place they were still called "Menaces" 
- fixed Russian sun; removed localised BH assets (dd23a345c)
- world-map flags, flowers distance, sunny zone extended to edge, passion button
- can't get chilly running along the Antibes beach any more
- fixed missing ref in chez felix (6d0cadc38)
- various antibes ordering fixes
- lots of copy/typo fixes

## 2026.8.k.6 - "AN EYE, A MECHANICAL EYE"

- You can now right-drag the camera
- the more zoomed out, the faster the camera movement
- if you've panned the camera around, it'll hold position until Spencer walks off screen
- if Spencer isn't moving, you can pan *as far as you could go to keep him onscreen at max zoom level* 
- this means you'll be able to see several bits of broken scenery towards the edge of the scene - you don't need to report 'em, we'll fix that shortly, but you can if you like :)
- FIXED, RELATEDLY: the brief bug where you could pan as far as you liked in every direction
- save-slot dates now respond, perhaps reluctantly, to your machine's regional settings
- You can't get to nine unread toast notifications any more. Try it! It can't be done!
- lots of copy fixes and typos, as ever

## 2026.8.j.87 - "MY SON WHAT HAVE YE DONE"

* crafting HUD gives you more info about what you've just crafted or want to craft
* camera correctly frames conversation with a certain Long
* fridge in sanitarium no longer empties if you don't open it on your first visit
* some shrouded rooms were showing outlines of internal objects after save->reload
* the cursor is less pessimistic about areas which are actually walkable
* bundle of bug fixes on the context menu for inventory
* only one response at a time should highlight now
* confirmation-delete now disappears if you close the menu that created it
* counterfeit State passport less fussy about which name you claimed
* Andrée's other business still available if you find another way to your goal
* Librairie sandwich board interactable before the first time you enter
* updated character sheet sprites
* lotsa narrative logic and copy fixes

## 2026.8.j.65 - "LANTERN HAS AN N"

* Hotfix becausethe 'Lantern' typo on the character generation screen was really embarrassing

## 2026.8.j.61 - "UNTITLED (LE PIANO), CA. 1948"

* If you chased the cat to the top of the piano, (a) take a long hard look at yourself in the mirror (b) you don't need to exit to the corridor before interacting with him
* fixed startup crash when game files are unreadable/unwritable I HOPE
* mouse pointer shake was showing up on non-16:9 displays, especially for users with Iris Xe chips. I *think* this should be a bit better now?
* discussing cigars no longer allow you to re-enact Aubière blackmail
* Zèlia no longer skips a step in conversation. She *is* intentionally confusing, but I hadn't actually noticed this
* Zèlia logic bug too fiendish to explain; but if you couldn't lie to her, revisit Aristide et al
* Bessy and Rodia should no longer unexpectedly dump you from the conversation
* that FECKING BOOKSTAND in the FIRST CUTAWAY is NOW FIXED
* fixed blank travel-permit tooltip on the Berlin destination; also hid descriptions for travel items you don't have yet
* Andree no longer sells an item you can easily find for free elsewhere
* copy fixes

## 2026.8.j.46 - "THE OTHER HALF OF THE TWIN"

* fixed sanitarium night music not playing at night
* Spencer now needs a shave even if he doesn't sleep properly (249d7a2f6)
* character-generation tooltips now safely limited to prevent confusion
* Linou no longer double-dips for sock juice
* one less memory from St Reparata's window
* character-sheet focus pane no longer blanks when clicked, hover on other skills isn't broken by upgrading a skill
* more Antibes pathing fixes
* fixed infinite-influence exploit on a clock and also a boat
* can no longer click NPCs unless you're inside their cutaway
* Vincent less inclined to teleport
* \[SPOILER] stops confusingly refusing to talk about \[SPOILER] once she's been given the word by \[SPOILER], \[SPOILER] or \[SPOILER]

* fixed a couple of bugs in Strathcoyne's dialogue, added a couple of responses

* Your new companion reliably joins you when you leave, rather than semi-accompanying you on the train
* Aristide now says 'Welllll' not 'Welll' so it's clearly intended, not a typo :)
* fixed flash before awakening
* Rites description made clearer
* 'or T' tooltip was missing from the choices hint (3b496165c)
* removed trailing space from Philomèle

## 2026.8.j.34 - "MASS FOR THE IMPRISONED"

* Lots more work on pathfinding in Antibes
* game ended at Dread/Fascination/Pain 11, not 10 - fixed now
* crafting HUD fixes: correct images, removed overlapping 'YOU ARE HERE'
* Grail reward hold-to-fill button updated (we fixed the spend-experience one last patch, missed this one until now)

* couldn't delete saves after leaving and retunring to main menu - can now
* Zèlia: added a tutorial warning that she's unpredictable, clarified a couple of player choices

## 2026.8.j.17 - "WHAT I WAS WALLING IN OR WALLING OUT"

* fixed those spots people where getting stranded - the café, that bloody flower in the park, a couple of other places. Loading after update should silently rescue you. Thank you to screamingreen-rocket, cadetgrey-sage, linen-madder, pearl-filipendula and many others!

* fixed mysterious Shivering message on exiting Sanitarium; climate also takes a few seconds to kick in when entering cutaways
* fixed a crash during scene transitions
* updated the Grail hold-to-fill button so you can see it filling
* Lewis painting in Sanitarium no longer visible before unshrouding
* Wardrobe header no longer misdirects to Skill Modifiers

## 2026.8.j.8 - "THE LITTLE BOX"

* helpful nudge towards the ESCAPE! button if you're clicking frustratedly
* added a 'beware, dabblers' tutorial message for occult activities
* it's now harder to die in the bath

## 2026.8.j.4 - "IMAGINARY HOTELS"

* btw these version labels are from Simic's book on Joseph Cornell, 'Dime-Store Alchemy', which I highly recommend. but I've almost run out

* that landscape seam in the art is now fixed. Thanks to EVERYONE who reported it :-)
* swapping stacks in the inventory borked stack number display - now fixed
* shortened invisible bag tooltip - I got carried away with the Dunsany quotes
